title: Preserve fermata position, type and length
scope: Add authored fermata records to the measure/beat model and retain them in GPIF import and GP8 export.
acceptance: Preserve Short, Medium and Long holds with distinct non-default lengths and offsets.
Assert two fermatas at different offsets and avoid sharing mutable data across reused definitions.
Check finite lengths, valid offsets and malformed payloads before conversion; compare exact consumer locations.
Preserve exact authored offsets while reporting pinned-consumer offset movement and collisions precisely; strict preservation must refuse unallowed loss with no output bytes.
Add pinned-consumer evidence for single-offset movement, fractional collisions at ticks 1/2 and 3/4, and whole-tick collisions at 122 and 123, plus retained ordinary offsets.
Document the fermata consumer limit and update the scoped capability assessment and verification receipt before closure.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at masterBars[1].fermata. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.

Strict export returns no diagnostics for fractional and whole-tick offset pairs that pinned AlphaTab collapses into one fermata. Exact GPIF/model offsets survive; the unreported consumer limit remains unresolved.
